Liam — quick prep checklist (copying a few items from env-checklist.txt):
- Example request/response sizes (average tokens per request + peak requests/min)
- Whether you'll test embeddings, chat, or both in the session
- Any network constraints (VPC only? public API allowed?)

If you can drop those answers into this thread or the shared Drive folder, I'll tune the demo. My planned flow: quick topology sketch (3–4 mins), live demo of a 2-stage inference pipeline with caching enabled (12 mins), and then targeted Q&A.

If Friday turns into a deep technical deep-dive, I'm happy to extend by 15 minutes — just tell me which topics to prioritize.
